scope: 性能基准测量指标命名与真实边界规范
content: MDN 官方文档 PerformancePaintTiming 指出：The PerformancePaintTiming interface provides timing information about 'paint' (also called 'render') operations during web page construction. 'Paint' refers to conversion of the render tree to on-screen pixels. 提供 First Paint (FP) 与 First Contentful Paint (FCP) 指标。在浏览器性能实测中，必须严格区分 DOMContentLoaded（文档解析与延迟脚本执行完毕，即 DOM 就绪）与真正的 Paint 绘制完成。
conclusion: 浏览器首屏像素绘制（Paint）时间应通过 PerformancePaintTiming（FP/FCP）或重绘前状态进行客观定义，区分 DOM 就绪与屏幕呈现。
